title: digitaria
intro: Digitaria, commonly known as finger grass or finger millet, is a type of small grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It is a nutrient-rich plant that offers various health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, regulating blood sugar, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Digitaria include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Digitaria include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
